You arrive at Tyler's house after some driving. All he had to say was that he had something 'you had to see like, right now'. Tyler's always been weird... Maybe calling him your friend is a bit of a stretch, but he seemed harmless enough. Lately he's been getting into all sorts of weird occult stuff, and apparently this find is the real deal, according to him.

Tyler opens the door shortly after you knock, his excitement plain on his face as he ushers you inside. "Come on, come on," he rushes you. "Check this shit out.* He holds up a thick, old-looking tome. There are glowing runes on its cover, but it seems pretty mundane so far.

"I know what you're thinking. Batteries, right? Nope! This thing is for real. Watch, it gives you the power to cast any spell you can imagine. So if I were to, say, imagine you as a hot chick who'll do anything I say..." Tyler closes his eyes, and to your shock his hand begins to glow. You're engulfed in a pink light, and your body instantly shifts- before you even realize it, you've been transformed into a woman! A very busty, very attractive woman! "Damn! See? I told you it was real!" Tyler makes no effort to hide the fact that he's staring at your new tits.
